differences.native: MySQL filters DATEDIFF('2019-06-30', login_date) BETWEEN 0 AND 90.
differences.app: SQLite filters login_date between date('2019-06-30', '-90 day') and '2019-06-30'.
differences.rationale: SQLite has no MySQL DATEDIFF function. Both predicates select the same inclusive calendar-date interval; the first-login CTE, projection, aggregation, aliases, and grouping otherwise match exactly.
